note: San Carlos RD (San Isabel NF) at 10,500 ft, 4 mi up gravel FSR 422 from CO-12 south of Cuchara; Blue Lake is a short walk north, Bear Lake a mile up the road. Trees blown down in 2022 were cleared in 2024, so the campground is treeless and can be very windy. --Claude

flags: Booking conflict: the FS page says 'The campground is strictly first come, first served', but recreation.gov sells 6 of the 16 sites (catalog reservable; Peak and Non-Peak rate seasons 06-12 to 09-26) and lists a first-come season 05-22 to 06-11. Recorded recreation.gov's split; the FS page looks stale (last updated February 3, 2026).

Max length conflict: FS page 'The max length for RVs/trailers is 40 feet'; recreation.gov catalog 35 ft (13 sites) and 36 ft (3). Set 40 (agency-stated; the stored 56 was a placeholder). All fit 23 ft.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront at a lake named Blue Lake): no lead. Blue Lake sits 180-380 m north of the sites (OSM; nearest sites 006/007 ~180 m); Cucharas Creek's headwater stream runs 30-120 m west of the loop in the trees (closest site 015 ~30 m). Imagery predates the 2024 clear-cut, so whether the north sites now see the lake can't be told; the FS page's 'streams ... run through the campground' is a creek, not a shore. Leave not waterfront.
Access: FSR 422 is 4 miles of gravel from CO-12 (paved over Cucharas Pass); no 4WD or big-rig warning on either page. The rough jeep road FSR 436 to Trinchera Peak is across the road and not needed.
Closures: none for this area. The PSICC's only current San Carlos closure (Aspen Acres Fire order 02-12-03-26-43, Oct 23 2026) covers Davenport Campground and roads in the Wet Mountains, not Cuchara.
